title: You are me
next_chapter_hook: "The residual shadow of Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago slowly extended his hand, pointing at the faintly visible Heavenly Secrets mark between his brows: 'I am your future, you are our hope. And now, you must make a choice — accept this ten-thousand-year destiny, or completely sever this cycle of cause and effect?'"

text.content: "The core of the source of destiny was a void of darkness, with only the faint glow emanating from the residual shadow like ancient stars. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value burning furiously, every trace of loss like the agony of having his marrow抽取ed, yet he had no retreat. That face, identical to his own, slowly lifted, its eyes reflecting ten thousand years of vicissitudes and solitude."

dialogue.content: "'You have finally arrived.' That voice was aged yet familiar, as if Chen Ji was speaking to his reflection in a mirror, 'Ten thousand years, I waited a full ten thousand years, finally another self of mine has arrived here.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji forced himself to calm down, the Tianji Record Fragment trembling slightly in his Mental Sea. He stared at that face exactly matching his own, his voice hoarse: 'Who are you? Why do you have my face?' Before the words finished, countless shattered images suddenly flashed through his mind — altar, blood light, endless falling."

dialogue.content: "The residual shadow sighed softly, raised his hand and waved, and a massive scroll materialized in the void. Within the scroll, a cultivator identical to Chen Ji stood upon an altar, behind him lay countless fallen bodies, yet his eyes burned with resolute light. 'I am the residual mark left after your sacrifice ten thousand years ago, the way this world remembers me.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji stared fixedly at that scroll, his pupils contracting sharply. The sacrifice scene in the painting was too tragic — it was no ordinary sacrifice, but a gamble wagering an entire civilization. His heart pounded violently, a terrible thought taking shape."

dialogue.content: "'Ten thousand years ago, there was a cultivator called 'me' who foresaw a catastrophe — the Heavenly Dao Will wanted to turn all living beings into nutrients, to restart the universe.' The residual shadow's voice carried a bitter smile, 'I tried to resist, only to discover that the Heavenly Dao itself was formed from the resentment of countless prophets, utterly impossible to defeat.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, his nails digging deep into his palms. He finally understood the truth behind the incomplete Tianji Record — it was no ordinary cultivation damage, but the most exquisite move laid by the First Ancestor in opposing the Heavenly Dao. 'So, you chose to sacrifice yourself, leaving behind the fire seed in the form of a destiny mark?'"

dialogue.content: "'Not only that.' The residual shadow shook his head, a trace of madness flickering in his eyes, 'I sealed all the Heavenly Secrets fragments I deduced in a single page, letting it autonomously choose an inheritor — that is the Tianji Record in your hands. And my residual consciousness transformed into this so-called 'Heavenly Dao Will,' becoming the guardian of this realm.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt a bout of vertigo. The Heavenly Dao Will — that ultimate enemy he thought he had to oppose, was actually himself from ten thousand years ago? Countless chaotic thoughts collided in his Mental Sea, his voice turning ice-cold: 'So from the very beginning, I was your chess piece? From the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, I was already being manipulated?'"

choice.prompt: "Faced with this shocking truth, Chen Ji's heart was churning like mighty waves. He had to make a choice — accept this arrangement from ten thousand years ago, or completely deny it all?"

choices.description: "Since the me from ten thousand years ago has already paved this road, then follow this karma, use his chess game to accomplish the unfinished business."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain qualification for unlocking the complete Tianji Record inheritance"
choices.risk_hint: "This path may cause you to completely become a continuation of the me from ten thousand years ago, losing independent will"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, letting those chaotic emotions churn in his heart. When he opened them again, his eyes had become a calm abyss. 'Very well.' The moment this word fell, the core of the source of destiny quaked violently, and a relieved smile appeared on the residual shadow's face."

dialogue.content: "'Excellent.' The residual shadow's voice trembled with joy, 'You are stronger than I imagined. Now, let me give you everything — the last three pages of the Tianji Record, and all my memories from ten thousand years.' With those words, a brilliant light burst forth from the residual shadow, rushing directly toward Chen Ji's brow center."

choices.description: "Even if you are the me from ten thousand years ago, I am not your chess piece! My fate, I decide for myself!"
choices.visible_cost: "Completely break with the Heavenly Dao Will"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve complete self-will, gain qualification to independently oppose the Heavenly Dao"
choices.risk_hint: "Lose the complete Tianji Record inheritance boost, face unknown dangers alone"

text.content: "Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, burning with unyielding fury. 'I don't care if you are me or whatever Heavenly Dao!' His voice rang like thunder exploding, 'When I, Chen Ji, act, I only ask my own heart! You set your schemes, I have my own path!'"

dialogue.content: "The residual shadow fell silent for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter, yet within the laughter was a trace of sorrow. 'Good! Good! Good!' Speaking three goods in succession, the residual shadow's figure began to twist violently, 'As expected of the one I chose — even daring to oppose me. This is what a true successor of Heavenly Secrets should be!'"

text.content: "When the light dispersed, Chen Ji felt countless unfamiliar memories appear in his Mental Sea. The sacrifice ten thousand years ago, the first confrontation with the Heavenly Dao Will, and the terrifying silhouette of that ultimate chess player — a being beyond comprehension, not even the Tianji Record could deduce its extent."

"However, what shocked Chen Ji even more were those memory fragments about his sister Chen Nian — so her being taken by the Holy Sect was not coincidence, but a plot laid ten thousand years ago. The four words 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' echoed endlessly in his mind — that was the key to opening the ultimate seal, and also the weakness he must protect."

choice.prompt: "After obtaining the memories from ten thousand years ago, Chen Ji finally understood everything. But now a more difficult choice lay before him — how should he face all this?"

choices.description: "Since we've come this far, completely restore the Tianji Record, use all the power accumulated by the me from ten thousand years ago to overturn the ultimate chess player's board."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely merge with the self from ten thousand years ago, possibly losing some emotions"
choices.visible_reward: "Tianji Record completeness reaches 100%, unlock the ultimate skill 'Heavenly Secrets Unity'"
choices.risk_hint: "The fusion process is extremely dangerous, any mishap will cause the soul to scatter"

text.content: "Chen Ji sat cross-legged, forming seals with both hands. In his Mental Sea, the residual shadow transformed into countless light particles merging into the depths of his soul. A powerful force surged from every limb and meridian, the Tianji Record fragments began to frantically complete themselves, and layers of mysterious patterns emerged upon them."

choices.description: "Only absorb the necessary memories and power, preserve the complete self. Since the me from ten thousand years ago chose me as the seed, that means he believed I could walk a different path."
choices.visible_cost: "Tianji Record completeness can only reach 80%, some skills cannot be used"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve independent personality and emotions, gain the special ability 'Command Heaven with Heart'"
choices.risk_hint: "May face insufficient strength when confronting the ultimate chess player"

text.content: "Chen Ji proactively suppressed those forces attempting to fuse, only selecting the most essential methods of Heavenly Secrets deduction. His consciousness stood firm like a rock in midstream, letting ten thousand years of memories rush past, yet always maintaining his original heart. The last wisp of the residual shadow's consciousness sighed softly in his ear: 'You are more suited to walk your own path than I imagined.'"

"When all was settled, the core of the source of destiny began to collapse. The residual shadow, having lost its consciousness support, glanced at Chen Ji one last time before dissipating, his lips moving: 'The ultimate chess player... he is always watching... don't let him discover your true purpose...' The voice grew fainter and fainter, finally dissipating completely into the void."

"Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, an unprecedented sense of crisis washing over him. That final sentence from his self of ten thousand years ago was like thunder — the ultimate chess player is always watching? Could it be that from the very beginning, his obtaining the Tianji Record and coming here, all were observed by that indescribable existence? He forced himself to remain calm, the Tianji Record spinning rapidly, beginning its deduction."

dialogue.content: "Just then, a gaze transcending sensory perception descended upon him from above. That gaze held no emotion, no temperature, yet it made Chen Ji's very soul tremble — it was a gaze from higher dimensions, a sight beyond the law of causality. Chen Ji felt every thought of his being seen through, every move of his being foreseen."

text.content: "However, just as that gaze was about to lock onto him, the residual will of ten thousand years ago within Chen Ji erupted violently, forming a weak barrier. That barrier existed only for an instant, yet it was enough for Chen Ji to capture a crucial piece of information — the ultimate chess player was not omnipotent, there were realms he could not reach."

"Chen Ji firmly fixed that direction in his mind — it was the source of the river of destiny, the origin of all cause and effect, and also the only forbidden zone the ultimate chess player could not taint. A cold smile slowly curled at the corner of his mouth: since you are always watching, then let you see — this chess game you have played for ten thousand years, today, begins to be overturned."

"The collapsing source of destiny spat Chen Ji back into the real world. He found himself standing in the ruins of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, surrounded by familiar grass and trees as well as brokenrestriction. Yet his eyes no longer held those of the cautious servant disciple from before, but belonged to a true successor of Heavenly Secrets carrying ten thousand years of karma."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji looked down at his hands, feeling the surging newborn power within. Once he had thought the Tianji Record was his golden finger, a福利 for the transmigrator. Now he understood, he himself was the seed cultivated by this realm to oppose the ultimate chess player. Ten thousand years ago he chose sacrifice, ten thousand years later he chose rebirth — the same choice, two lives, yet pointing to the same destination."

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze becoming unprecedentedly resolute. He was no longer a chess piece manipulated by the Tianji Record, but a chess player carrying the will of two lifetimes. The ultimate chess player is watching all this? Then let him watch closely — how atrash servant disciple would overturn his entire chess game step by step."

"In the distance, on the main peak of the Tianqing Sect, a fierce aura was approaching. Chen Ji sensed it was the spiritual awareness of the old sect master Ling Yuan — it seemed his disturbance when leaving the Forbidden Grounds had already alerted that old fox who appeared to shelter him but harbored hidden malice. A playful arc curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth: 'Just in time.' He just needed a whetstone to test exactly how strong this newborn power from ten thousand years later was."
